## Execution audit

**Scope and provenance.** The principal case is `commons_109923183`, `ours_without_probes`, development C1. For citations X0213–X0219, the expanded-file directory is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/ours_without_probes/C1/development/commons_109923183/`. Their archive is `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/ablation_r1--ours_without_probes.tar.gz`; each member has the corresponding suffix under `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/ours_without_probes/C1/development/commons_109923183/`. Citations below identify the file suffix and exact source lines.

**Representation and intent.** The final build constructs a paneled room with individually colored, rotated parquet boxes, molding and rod panel borders; glazing and curtains are approximated with a box and vertical rods [X0213, `build.py`, lines 88–152]. The chaise is a composite of swept legs, spherical feet, rounded frame and mattress, a tilted padded back, tubular rims and arms, and small spherical ornaments [X0213, lines 154–221]. A separate tilted pillow and seamed outline, green card with four tiny printing boxes, and foreground chair with crossing cane rods and added legs complete the scene [X0213, lines 238–285]. These are geometric approximations, not evidence that their connections physically touch or that they match the reference. The stated support chain is intent; the functional record leaves support/collision truth and semantic completeness null [X0213, lines 13–15; X0214, `record.json`, lines 25–34].

**Materials and surface detail.** The script uses named RGB colors, seeded per-plank color variation, and geometry for stripes, embroidery and cane rather than an explicit image-texture operation [X0213, lines 35–51, 91–100, 222–236, 264–276]. After realization it copies materials per semantic subtree, sets Principled roughness to 0.79 or 0.90 when that node exists, and smooths meshes with more than 12 polygons in selected subtrees [X0213, lines 287–329]. This describes code operations, not a measured appearance.

**Pose and render setup.** The final code widens chaise, pillow and label together by 1.25 in Y and rotates them −16° around the origin; the mattress's pre-transform dimensions are 2.86 × 1.12 × 0.26 in arbitrary units [X0213, lines 26–33, 174–176, 248–262]. Camera is `(−0.69, −5.04, 3.64)`, target `(−0.19, 0.10, 1.02)`, lens 48; it specifies 512 × 384 at 100%, AgX, ambient strength 0.22, and two warm area emitters of power 440 and 65 [X0213, lines 17–20, 47–49, 331–354]. These are specified settings, not independent geometry measurements.

**Iteration and actual execution.** Step 1 used a different camera and stronger daylight; its source explicitly says no render measurement had yet occurred [X0217, `steps/001/build.py`, lines 6–21, 45–46]. Its result subsequently reports Blender 4.2.10, 16/16 samples finished, a saved PNG and blend file, `ok: true`, null error and empty stderr [X0218, `steps/001/result.json`, lines 2–7]. Step 2 code reports the author's observations that the chaise was too small in frame and the chair insufficiently cropped, then changes camera and applies a shared rotation [X0219, `steps/002/build.py`, lines 6–14, 18–21, 258–261]. The final build describes further framing, width and lighting revisions as responses to step 2; those are author observations, not independently inspected images [X0213, lines 4–13].

The record reports three executions, completion on CPU, null runtime error and no failure type; it does not itself show the selected step's render log [X0214, lines 16, 37–53, 58–86]. `selected.json` records step 3, although the record's `selected` field is null [X0215, `selected.json`, lines 1–3; X0214, line 57]. Thus the supplied evidence supports completed run status, but not a separately inspected step-3 image or detailed step-3 execution log for this case.

**Validation and quality.** The record reports valid=true, SSIM 0.272, LPIPS 0.714, DINO 0.556, PSNR 13.464 and overall 0.445; structural, material and composite checks pass, explicitly as edit-operability checks [X0214, lines 17–34]. These numbers and passes are recorded outcomes, not independent acceptance of visual fidelity. No images are attached, so visual quality cannot be judged here: successful rendering and potentially poor reconstruction are distinct.

A separate test case, `commons_199974832`, also has a step-3 successful 16-sample render and saved PNG/blend, but must not be conflated with the chaise case [X0211, expanded file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/generic_same_structured_evidence/C1/test/commons_199974832/steps/003/result.json`, lines 2–7; archive `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/ablation_r1--generic_same_structured_evidence.tar.gz`, member `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/results/ablation_r1/generic_same_structured_evidence/C1/test/commons_199974832/steps/003/result.json`].
